Class BlockGraphics

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Rendering
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents various information about a block's graphics. Notably it's texture and shape.

Methods

GetTextureCarriedVariation(BlockPos, uint, int)

Retrieves the texture UV coordinates for a specific block face and variant at the given world position. Carried is generally used in the UI, the carried grass texture is hardcoded green while the default one is grayscale.

public TextureUVCoordinates GetTextureCarriedVariation(BlockPos worldPosition, uint mappedBlockFace, int blockVariant)

Parameters

worldPosition BlockPos

The position of the block in the world.

mappedBlockFace uint

Generally, the face of the block for which the texture is being retrieved, mapped as you need to rotate blocks yourself.

blockVariant int

The variant of the block, used to determine the specific texture to retrieve, like wood types. This may not always be just Data.

Returns

TextureUVCoordinates

The TextureUVCoordinates representing the UV coordinates of the texture for the specified block face and variant.

GetTextureCarriedVariations(uint, int)

Retrieves the default texture variations for a specified block face and block variant. Carried is generally used in the UI, the carried grass texture is hardcoded green while the default one is grayscale.

public TextureUVCoordinates[] GetTextureCarriedVariations(uint mappedBlockFace, int blockVariant)

blockVariant int

The variant of the block, used to determine the specific texture to retrieve, like wood types. This may not always be just Data.

Returns

TextureUVCoordinates[]

An array of TextureUVCoordinates representing the default texture variations for the specified block face and variant.
